symptom: Changed input at same path reuses stale preparation
reproduce: python lab.py --workspace .lab run; edit .lab/input.txt; run again
expected: New content produces a new cache key and PREPARED
observed: CACHE_HIT because key was based only on path
root_cause: cache_key hashed str(data_path), not file bytes and config

symptom: Incomplete or foreign evaluation may be accepted
observed: Only truthiness of report.passed was checked
root_cause: validate_release did not validate required manifest/report fields, hashes, runtime, or metrics

reproduce: Run publish while mocking os.replace to raise
expected: Old target bytes remain; temporary file is removed
observed: write_text overwrote the target in place
root_cause: Publication had no sibling temporary file, fsync, atomic replace, or cleanup

symptom: Retry records the same release more than once
reproduce: Run lab.py --workspace .lab run twice in separate processes
expected: One journal row for the same manifest and evaluation
observed: Every successful retry appended a publication row
root_cause: The journal append had no content identity, deduplication, or retry recovery

symptom: Requests are served during backend warmup
reproduce: Start service.py --warmup-seconds 10; immediately GET /ready and POST /generate
expected: Health may be up; ready and generation return 503 until warmup finishes
observed: ready was true at construction and generate ignored warmup
root_cause: Readiness was hard-coded true and generation did not gate on warmup

symptom: Metadata can advertise a version that is not loaded
reproduce: Start service with accepted A; publish B without restarting; POST /generate
expected: Response and debug continue to identify loaded A until restart
observed: Backend retained A but response reread accepted.json and advertised B
root_cause: Response metadata was fetched from the mutable pointer on every request

symptom: Malformed generation requests still reach the backend
observed: No prompt or token-limit validation before generate
root_cause: HTTP handler forwarded unvalidated JSON directly to backend
